note: Nebraska Game and Parks SRA on 20 sandpit lakes (~300 water acres) just west of Fremont off US-30. The main RV camping is the Pathfinder (sites 1-97) and Victory Lake (98-168) loops: Electric Plus 50 A on paved pads under mature shade. Many Victory Lake sites, and the north row of Pathfinder, back onto the lake. Smaller Electric (30 A) loops at Cottonwood and Fishermen's Point. Basic and primitive sites ring the other lakes. No water or sewer at the sites. Showers, modern restrooms, dump stations. Swimming beach, PWC area, grill on Victory Lake. State park entry permit required. --Claude
